children: Evolution Metals & Technologies entered multiple financing agreements with Yorkville, led by a Securities Purchase Agreement to issue up to $30.93 million in convertible debentures. The debentures price at 97% of principal, carry 4% annual interest (18% on default), mature Sep 17, 2028, and are convertible at the lower of $5.02 or 95% of the lowest five-day VWAP, subject to a floor, Nasdaq exchange cap, and a 4.99% ownership blocker. A Registration Rights Agreement obligates the company to file an S-1 to register resale of conversion shares and grants piggyback rights, while a Global Guarantee Agreement provides subsidiary guarantees of the obligations. Proceeds will support operations and development initiatives.
